description: The former star boxer, 'Dylan,' who is barely living while paying off debt by participating as a fighter in an illegal fighting ring known only to a select few. Then, 'Harry,' the CEO of a famous company, appears before him. A man who needs a lot of money, looks stylish, and above all... has eyes full of venom. Dylan perfectly matched the conditions for the slave that Harry was looking for, and as a result, he is offered a master-servant relationship by him. ?"You, you have to be my slave." ?However, despite thinking it was just a relationship to pay off his debts, Dylan begins to wonder why he doesn't want to run away, even when he's tied up and whipped. His mind becomes filled with both the thought of wanting to utterly destroy Harry, and the conflicting thought that he wants Harry to dominate him. Eventually, he even starts waiting for Harry to contact him first. ?This is a deep, deep love story between two men.
